# FitFusion

> FitFusion (fit-fusion.eu) is a free, science-based fitness calculator toolkit with BMI, BMR, daily calorie (TDEE), and macronutrient calculators, a food nutrition search, a personalized supplement guide, and an evidence-based health blog. All content is available in English, Hungarian, and Spanish.

All calculators run in the browser using published formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor for BMR, WHO BMI classification, USDA macronutrient guidance). Results are educational and not medical advice.

## Calculators

- [BMI Calculator](https://fit-fusion.eu/bmi): Body Mass Index with WHO categories, metric and imperial units, and a visual gauge
- [BMR Calculator](https://fit-fusion.eu/bmr): Basal Metabolic Rate using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation
- [Daily Calorie Calculator](https://fit-fusion.eu/calories): TDEE estimate from BMR and activity level, with goal-based targets
- [Macro Calculator](https://fit-fusion.eu/macros): Protein, carbohydrate, and fat breakdown for a calorie target and fitness goal
- [Food Nutrition Search](https://fit-fusion.eu/food): Look up calories and macronutrients for common foods

## Guides

- [Fitness Tips](https://fit-fusion.eu/tips): Practical, evidence-based training and nutrition tips
- [Supplement Guide](https://fit-fusion.eu/supplements): Personalized, science-backed supplement recommendations

## Blog

- [Health & Fitness Blog](https://fit-fusion.eu/blog): Articles on nutrition, workouts, and wellness in English, Hungarian, and Spanish
- [RSS Feed](https://fit-fusion.eu/feed.xml): Latest blog posts
